source_evidence: Verified local HEAD, origin/fix/pending-code-deployment-guard, and the open CompleteDotTech/jev-factorio-agent PR #45 head all resolve to 09a19140c607118d11a615fd51475feece98a9c6.

Supervisor.watch_game reads the checkpoint before launch and, when pending is present and source provenance is absent, unavailable, or changed, calls begin_repair('checkpoint_reconciliation') and returns before record_revision or launch.

The new regression test makes popen fail if invoked and verifies the exact checkpoint JSON, including pending, active_plan, step_index, and reservations, remains unchanged while the immutable incident checkpoint retains it.
The manual-intervention guard rejects a changed source revision with pending work before audit/state mutation, closing that alternate provenance path.

The write-ahead controller persists pending and reservations before dispatch, resumes through pending verification before new planning/dispatch, and its existing ambiguity paths do not blindly replay mutations.

The diff does not change fair action code: the native fair adapter retains actual player walking, normal mining with can_reach_entity, standard build/insert reach checks, and actor enforcement of game.speed == 1 with cheat mode disabled.
Focused isolated tests passed: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_supervisor.py tests/test_hierarchical.py tests/test_fair_actions.py (101 passed).
